Foo!  (moby!)

The interrupt handler for ^S doesn't seem to check for TYO being an SFA
before getting the "channel" to do an output reset on!!!  Needless to
say, this can cause gross lossage when your losing VT52 types on for you
at unexpected moments.  And the only way to continue the LISP is to
open the channel from DDT so you can fake it out.

Can this get patched please??
